## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass (and the backend or worker tests, if touched)
- [ ] A bug fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] Files are processed in the browser, or the page says what goes to a server before it is sent
- [ ] Tool copy and docs state only what the code does
- [ ] `npm run docs:tools` was run if a tool was added, renamed or removed
